newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt realty firm boosts 95/96 profit.
newsitem.headline: Egypt realty firm boosts 95/96 profit.

text.p: Heliopolis Housing and Development nearly doubled net after-tax profits in the financial year 1995/96 to 61.35 million pounds ($18 million) from 34.07 million in the previous year, results published on Monday showed.
The financial year ends on June 30.
The firm said it would distribute 45.73 million pounds of this profit to shareholders compared to the 28.39 million pounds it gave out in 1994/1995.
This would give shareholders a dividend equivalent to 9.25 pounds.

The Egyptian government last month said it was auctioning five percent or more of its shares in the partially-privatised firm to at least one strategic investor. The state currently owns 72.86 percent of the firm.

The deadline for bids to buy the shares was supposed to have been November 28 but brokers said they believe the government decided instead to sell the shares through the stock exchange when the stock's value on the bourse began to increase.
The stock last traded on Monday at 325 pounds, up from an average of 172.5 last month when the government announced the auction.
The results showed that Heliopolis sales for 1995/96 were higher at 138.37 million pounds compared to 57.73 million in the previous year.
Shareholders' equity rose to 57.75 million pounds from 48.32 million in the previous year.
